players.product: holding parent of GlobalWafers (46.64% stake; semiconductor wafers incl. 300mm reported through GlobalWafers), with its own solar silicon / cells and renewable-energy businesses

quarterly_data.signal: Sino-American Silicon's Q2 2026 results deck: consolidated revenue NT$21.1 billion, up 8.96% QoQ (record-high Q2 revenue for the same period, per the company), driven by solid core business growth and rising contributions from the group's diversified businesses; 1H26 revenue NT$40.5 billion, up 2.26% YoY. Gross margin 22.7% in Q2 (1H26 22.9%) and operating margin 10.6%; the company says Q2 gross and operating margins declined mainly on higher depreciation and ramp-up costs at subsidiary GlobalWafers' newly expanded facilities. Q2 net profit NT$4,453 million (net margin 21.1%) and EPS NT$3.19, with profit before tax up QoQ mainly on mark-to-market gains on Siltronic shares held by GlobalWafers.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 2026 revenue NT$21.1 billion (+8.96% QoQ); 1H26 NT$40.5 billion (+2.26% YoY); GM 22.7%; net profit NT$4,453 million; EPS NT$3.19

players.product: Electronic-grade disilane (Si2H6) and trisilane (Si3H8) CVD deposition gases and anhydrous hydrogen fluoride (AHF) dry-etch gas; through subsidiary Hong Jie Technology, ultra-high-purity cleaning and plasma-spray coating of CVD / etch equipment parts

quarterly_data.signal: Group affiliate Sino-American Silicon's Q2 2026 deck on Taiwan Speciality Chemicals (TSC): in 1H26 standalone revenue rose 29.7% YoY and consolidated revenue reached NT$1.7 billion, up 262.8% YoY, with consolidated revenue and EPS at record highs. The core disilane product continues to benefit from strong order visibility and sustained customer demand, with capacity expansion planned to meet demand; AHF has entered stable supply while certifications progress across multiple semiconductor customers; the first precursor product is undergoing customer qualification and process evaluations. Subsidiary Hung Jie Technology (HJT, component cleaning / coating / maintenance): 1H26 revenue NT$782.7 million (+6.4% YoY), record-high revenue as advanced-process projects entered mass production after qualification; capacity is approaching full utilization, with the Hsinchu and Tainan expansions progressing to plan, and advanced packaging projects in customer validation.
quarterly_data.figure: 1H26 consolidated revenue NT$1.7 billion (+262.8% YoY); standalone +29.7% YoY; HJT 1H26 revenue NT$782.7 million (+6.4% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: Parent Sino-American Silicon's Q2 2026 deck (GlobalWafers section) adds: GlobalWafers' prepayment stood at NT$20.8 billion (US$0.66 billion at NTD:USD 31.85, including guarantee); Q2 inventories rose QoQ mainly due to an inventory build-up in preparation for anticipated demand in H2; and Q2 gross margin stayed broadly stable QoQ despite revenue growth, reflecting higher depreciation, compensation accruals and freight and energy cost pressures. Company view: technology roadmaps are tightening advanced wafer supply - AI, new packaging technologies and process migration raise wafer intensity and qualification requirements, and supply-demand conditions remain tight across selected high-specification products given strong demand and a limited number of suppliers able to produce qualified advanced wafers.
